newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Trans-Caledon Tunnel $100 mln issue launched.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Trans-Caledon Tunnel $100 mln issue launched.

text.p: LONDON July 30 (LPC) - Arrangers Bankgesellschaft Berlin, Credit Suisse, DKB and Fuji have launched the $100 million three-year term loan for the Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority.
The debut borrowing is priced at 32.5 bps over LIBOR, and comes with the guarantee of the Republic of South Africa.
Bankers invited to participate in the loan said that although the deal's pricing is on the tight side, the Republic's guarantee goes a long way towards mitigating lenders' qualms.

The deal is, however, expected to mop up liquidity left over from the Republic of South Africa's $1.5 billion three-year revolving credit, which was priced at 30 bps over LIBOR, as a number of smaller institutions were unable to join the sovereign deal due to the large size of the commitments required -- banks joining the Republic's deal were asked for either $50 or $25 million.

Launch of the deal was postponed until the closure of the Republic's financing to give the Republic a free market. The deal funds the operation and maintenance of the South African part of the Lesotho Highlands water project.
